decisive_items: diffuse infiltrate in the upper dermis of medium-to-large mononuclear cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and reniform nuclei
positivity for CD1a and S100 protein
response.rationale: Biopsy findings and IHC are diagnostic of Langerhans cell histiocytosis; seborrheic dermatitis is only a prior clinical label and lacks these features.

rejected.why: Scalp lesions were only previously diagnosed as seborrheic dermatitis; biopsy and IHC do not support this diagnosis.
